latin_incipit: Nulla est scientia quae nos magis certificet de divinitate Christi, quam magia et Cabala

english_translation.text: There is no knowledge that gives us more certainty of Christ's divinity than magic and Kabbalah

exegesis: Pico's conclusion on Kabbalah within the Condemned Propositions tradition.
